decisions.reason: As the flagship platform with several models at the core of the firm's strategic direction, it plausibly meets aspirations, and a growing industry provides the slack to keep developing it.

Mobile field data capture is close to the established offer and was consistently presented on its own page, so there is no evidence of a shortfall that would trigger problemistic search, although the lack of recent website data adds uncertainty.

The search extension was actively updated to version 1.6.0, which signals ongoing customer demand, but small map.apps plugins from this firm have been pruned before, so the risk of dropping it is moderate.
